definition: the state of being a friend; association as friends; friendship.
example_en: Their friendship grew from childhood.

definition: to be eaten.
example_en: All the rice was eaten up by the dogs.

definition: the site of a battle; a battle-field.
example_en: The soldiers stood holding weapons on the battlefield.

definition: hurriedly; in a haste.
example_en: As the rain began, people ran hurriedly.

definition: a cleaning or washing using water; cleansing.
example_en: Before the worship, the vessels were cleansed with water.

definition: past; gone by; over; bygone.
example_en: He remembered the bygone days.

definition: to contemplate (on a deity or in abstract ); to meditate.
example_en: The devotee meditates on god every morning.

definition: a calamity, to happen; an unfortunate incident, event to befall.
example_en: A calamity suddenly befell that family.

definition: a container for burning fragrant resins to get incense.
example: ಪೂಜಾರಿ ಧೂಪಘಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಂಡ ಹಾಕಿ ಧೂಪ ಹೊತ್ತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The priest put embers in the incense burner and lit the incense.

definition: a person of noble family or noble conduct.
example_en: That noble man received respect from everyone.

definition: of, relating to, derived from or appealing to the intellect; intellectual.
example_en: His was an intellectual line of reasoning.

definition: a dot or dots marked for drawing decorative designs and figures on the ground with coloured powder or powders.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಹಾಸಕ್ಕಿಯಿಂದ ರಂಗೋಲಿ ಬಿಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She drew a rangoli in front of the house with coloured decorative dots.

definition: a man to whom a debt is owed; esp. to whom money or goods are due; a creditor.
example: ಸಾಲಗಾರ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳೂ ತನ್ನ ಋಣಸ್ಥನಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The borrower paid interest to his creditor every month.

definition: a thick rope, cable made of intertwisted strands of fibre, thin wires, etc.
example_en: They tied the cart's oxen tightly with a thick rope.

definition: resolved; determined.
example_en: His resolved goal was clear.

definition: (used to modify the verb equivalent 'to grieve', 'to weep' ) excessively.
example_en: She wept excessively.

definition: a place on the bank of a river or stream, where people can walk down upto the water.
example_en: The villagers went down to the river through the bank descent.

definition: to lose one's strength from or as from heat; (?).
example_en: Having walked in the heat, he lost his strength and fell.

definition: to tell, narrate a story or account of.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ನಮಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಘಟನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕತೆವೇೞ್ದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother narrated to us the account of the old incident.

definition: electricity produced by water power.
example_en: Hydroelectricity is supplied to this town.

definition: each time; every time.
example_en: Every time, he makes the same mistake.

definition: the tree Santalum album (=Sirium myrtifolium) of Santalaceae family.
example: ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ಕಾಲಾನುಸಾರ್ಯ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A sandalwood tree has grown in front of the temple.

definition: the backside of the body.
example_en: Mud stuck to the clothes and the backside of the body got dirty.

definition: a woman who makes and sells garlands of flowers.
example: ಪೂವಡೆ ದಿನವೂ ತಾಜಾ ಹೂಗಳಿಂದ ಹಾರ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The flower-garland woman made garlands with fresh flowers every day.

definition: the brown-skinned tuber of the plant, Solanum tuberosum of Solanaceae family; potato.
example_en: Mother cut and cooked the potatoes.

definition: self-motivation; inspiration from within.
example_en: This work of his was done out of self-motivation.

definition: the wool-like soft, curly hair.
example_en: The child's soft curly hair looked adorable.

definition: a woman who has expert knowledge and keen discrimination in classism.
example: ಆ ಮಾರ್ಗವಿದೆ ಸಮಾಜದ ವರ್ಗಭೇದವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಲ್ಲಳು.
example_en: That woman well understands the class distinctions of society.

definition: (mus.) a scale of time; .
example_en: The mridangam player played the chautala and kept the rhythm.

definition: a machine for changing mechanical energy into electrical energy; an electric generator; a dynamo.
example_en: They have installed a new dynamo in that factory.

definition: to bring up with care; to rear; to foster.
example_en: They lovingly reared and fostered the orphan children.

definition: a cloth that is never-washed.
example_en: He wore a never-washed cloth for the worship.

definition: a man belonging to a caste the main profession of the members of which is trading and business; a trader; a merchant.
example_en: That kōmaṭi (merchant) was famous in the grocery trade.

definition: strong sexual appetate; sexual desire.
example_en: The hero's strong sexual desire is described in that poem.

definition: a shaking vehemently.
example_en: The wind shook the tree vehemently.

definition: to commence; to start (doing something); to undertake.
example_en: He commenced the new task.

definition: (shaking, shivering etc.) in tremulous motion; waveringly.
example_en: His hands trembled shakily in the cold.

definition: a doubt; a suspecion.
example_en: I had a doubt about his words.

definition: (beauty) to become conspicuous.
example_en: With the adornment, the child's face became conspicuously beautiful.

definition: a meeting or union of two or more persons, things, together.
example_en: A conference of writers took place in the city.

definition: a person, who cannot stand on his or her own, not having parents or other guardian; an orphan.
example_en: The orphanage raised that orphan child.

definition: the feeling of surprise, admiration, and awe aroused by something strange, unexpected, incredible, etc.
example: ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿತ್ರವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಬಣ್ಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸೋಜಿಗ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the strange colours in the sky, everyone felt astonishment and wonder.

definition: wet, soggy earth or something resembling this; slush; mire.
example_en: After it rained, the whole path had become slush.

definition: a piece of ground where vegetables, fruits, flowers ornamental shrubs or trees, etc. are grown; a garden.
example: ಅವಳ ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ತೋಟ ಇದೆ.
example_en: Behind her house there is a beautiful garden.

definition: the force, impetuousness with which a thing is done or being done.
example_en: The bridge broke due to the force of the flood.

definition: a room or compartment containing a large receptacle for urinating or defecating into, usu. flushed and cleansed by water and connected to a sewage system; a lavatory.
example_en: They have built two lavatories in the new house.

definition: one who cuts, severs.
example_en: The severer cut the rope in one stroke.

definition: to chase - a) to follow quickly or persistently in order to catch or harm; b) to run after; to follow; to pursue.
example_en: The soldiers chased the enemies and drove them beyond the border.

definition: a signal made in response to a signal by another.
example_en: He nodded in response to the signal from her eye.

definition: derision; ridicule - a) the act of making someone or something the object of scornful laughter by joking, mocking, etc.; derision; b) words or actions intended to produce such laughter.
example_en: It is not good to ridicule the one who has lost.

definition: a useless object.
example_en: The broken vessel is now merely a useless object.

definition: the dust sitting on the foot or feet.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ಕಾಲುದೂಳಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After finishing the journey, the dust on his feet was visible.

definition: a disorder in the bodily system of a woman which obstructs periodic discharge of menses.
example_en: She developed the disorder called obstructed menstruation.

definition: the tendency of a person capturing others and confining in jails.
example_en: That tendency of capturing and jailing people instilled fear among the citizens.

definition: a heinous, abominable murder.
example_en: His heinous murder brought shock to everyone.

definition: the tip of one's finger.
example_en: His fingertip was cut by the knife.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: Praise came from everywhere for the good deed.

definition: to come to an end.
example_en: The evening market quickly came to an end.

definition: a written, legal document.
example: ಆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ದಸ್ತ ಐವಜ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The legal document of that land is not yet ready.

definition: a small rattle drum, used by mendicant fortune tellers.
example_en: The fortune teller told the future while beating the small rattle drum.

definition: a bag made of thin rubber or other light material, usu. brightly coloured, inflated with air or with some lighter-than-air gas and used as a children's plaything or as a decoration; a balloon.
example_en: The child inflated the balloon and played with it.

definition: a male human being.
example_en: According to the treatise, 'pum' means a male.

definition: a person who travels or is travelling.
example_en: That traveller has toured many countries.

definition: land or real estate owned; a property.
example_en: He had a large landed property in the village.

definition: absolute darkness; complete absence of light; pitch-darkness.
example_en: On the new-moon night, pitch-darkness had spread everywhere.

definition: the state of being languished; an instance of drooping.
example_en: The plant languished for lack of water.

definition: a king of elephants; an excellent elephant.
example_en: That excellent elephant was as strong as a white elephant.

definition: to become the target of; to be aimed at.
example_en: That town became the target of lack of rain.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example: ಅವಳು ಚುಟಕಿ ಹೊಡೆದು ಹಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾಳ ಹಾಕಿದಳು.
example_en: She snapped her fingers with a chutaki sound and kept beat for the song.

definition: to make into a ball, coil or cylinder by winding over and over itself or something else.
example_en: The grandmother wound the thread into a ball.

definition: the evergreen tree Olea dioca of Oleaceae family; Indin wild olive.
example_en: Indian wild olive trees are found at the foothills.

definition: the act of grinding the food with the molar teeth.
example: ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವಿಸುವಾಗ ಸರಿಯಾದ ನೆಮರು ಜೀರ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Proper chewing while eating food aids digestion.

definition: to struggle, strive hard ( as in carrying a heavy load).
example_en: He struggled hard carrying the heavy sack.

definition: the thorny, bushy plant Acacia concinna of Mimoseae family, grown as a hedge plant.
example: ರೈತರು ಹೊಲದ ಬೇಲಿಗೆ ಶೀಗೆ ಗಿಡ ನೆಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The farmers planted the thorny shige bush as a hedge for the field.

definition: the act or profession of farming on one's own land.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಮತ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಜೀವನ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He earns his livelihood by farming his own land.

definition: a thin sheet of metal, paper, etc., in which a pattern or lettering is cut, for producing a corresponding pattern on the surface beneath by the application of ink, paint, etc.; a stencil.
example_en: He placed the stencil on the wall and applied paint.

definition: to drink the rice-gruel, porridge.
example_en: The patient got up in the morning and drank the rice gruel.

definition: (the physical form of something) to be vanished; to disappear.
example_en: The mountain's form disappeared in the mist.

definition: the act of giving great joy or pleasure to another.
example_en: The child's smile gave great joy to the parents.

definition: not to be or that cannot be, shaken; firm; steady.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆ ಅಚಾಲ್ಯ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಒತ್ತಿದರೂ ಅಲುಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That rock was immovable; it did not budge however much it was pushed.

definition: the quality or fact of having a body or tangible form.
example: ದೇವರು ಸಕಾಯ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಕ್ತರ ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: God appeared before the devotees in a tangible bodily form.

definition: a place, building where sick and injured persons are medically treated.
example_en: They took the injured to the nearby hospital.

definition: to blind a person's eyes by dazzling brightness or splendour.
example: ಪ್ರಖರ ಬೆಳಕು ಕಣ್ಣುಕುಕ್ಕಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಏನೂ ಕಾಣಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The bright light dazzled his eyes and he could see nothing.

definition: a small peg used by weavers while weaving.
example_en: The weaver used the small peg while weaving cloth.

definition: to go out of sight; to disappear.
example_en: The hunter kept disappearing into the forest bushes.

definition: concluding one's fast undertaken for religious purpose by eating something; breakfast.
example: ಉಪವಾಸ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆತ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳಿಂದ ಬಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: After the fast ended, he broke it with fruits.

definition: the liquid secreted in the eyes; tear.
example: ಆ ದುಃಖದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಆಲಿನೀರು ಬಂತು.
example_en: Tears came to her eyes on hearing that sad news.

definition: to save from spending or wasting; to preserve for future use.
example_en: She saved a little money from her salary.

definition: a string of beads used in religious prayers; a rosary.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಅಕ್ಷಮಾಲಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದು ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: Grandmother holds her rosary every day and prays.

definition: an unrealised expectation, desire etc.
example_en: All his hopes remained as unrealised expectations.

definition: to make (food) into small balls for eating.
example_en: Mother made the rice into small balls and fed the child.

definition: to arrive at a solution; to take a decision; to decide.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೇರಿ ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone gathered in the meeting and decided on a matter.

definition: the act of a person or animal that hunts (either as a sport or for living).
example_en: The king went to the forest for hunting in the evening.

definition: a medicinal plant.
example_en: The hakkisiḷḷegiḍa plant grows at the edge of the forest.

definition: the act of bowing or bending oneself.
example_en: The disciple bowed and paid respects to the teacher.

definition: to cry aloud; to shout.
example_en: Seeing the danger, he cried aloud.

definition: to free a prisoner from the jail.
example_en: The judge freed that prisoner from jail.

definition: the profession of a person appointed for the service of a king.
example_en: He served the king in his appointed service.

definition: related to the soul, activities or properties of life or living beings; biotic.
example_en: Biotic activities take place in plants.

definition: a hole in the ground in which to bury a dead body; a grave.
example_en: They prepared his grave in the cemetery.

definition: a luminous body falling on the earth's surface during day-time; a meteor.
example: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಗಲುಳುಕು ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಜನರನ್ನು ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A daytime meteor appeared in the afternoon sky and astonished the people.

definition: the expulsion of bad smelling gas, caused by indigestion, through the mouth from the stomach.
example_en: After the meal, he had a sour burp from indigestion.

definition: the quality, habit of a person who habitually annoys another; nuisance.
example_en: The neighbours were fed up with his habit of causing nuisance.

definition: a friendly, kindly or benevolent attitude.
example_en: His friendly, benevolent attitude won everyone's heart.

definition: the back or hind part.
example_en: The children walked in the back part of the procession.

definition: a bird-catcher.
example: ಆ ಪುಳುಂಗಾಱ ಬಲೆ ಹಾಕಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That bird-catcher used to trap birds with a net.

definition: dimension of both length and breadth.
example_en: They measured the length and breadth of this ground.

definition: to render into small pieces; to split with violence; to rend; to tear off.
example_en: He tore the paper into pieces in anger.

definition: to counter or oppose with equal strength or force.
example_en: The army advanced, countering the enemies with equal strength.

definition: red granite stone.
example_en: Red granite stone is found abundantly on that hill.

definition: to be arrested; to be subject to another's control.
example_en: That thief was arrested at the border.

definition: to play for fun, recreation.
example_en: The children were playing about happily in the open field.

definition: a renowned, famous man; a celebrity.
example_en: That celebrated man was famous throughout the country.

definition: persons related to oneself by one's birth.
example: ಮದುವೆಯಾದ ನಂತರ ಅವಳು ತೌರಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಬಂದಳು.
example_en: After her marriage, she came to her birth-family's home for the first time.

definition: a kind of powder, that gives a sparkling effect when sprinkled on a surface.
example: ಅವಳು ಮುಖಕ್ಕೆ ಜಿಗಣೆ ಸಿಂಪಡಿಸಿ ಹೊಳೆಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She sprinkled the sparkling powder on her face to make it shine.

definition: the plant Calotropis gigantea.
example_en: They use the milky sap of the asphota plant for medicine.

definition: (myth.) any of the eight regents of directions.
example_en: Each regent of direction guards one direction.

definition: to dissociate oneself from; to separate oneself from.
example_en: She dissociated herself from her friends.

definition: to express contempt or hatred by or as if by spitting saliva; to spit.
example: ಆ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಜನರು ಥೂಕರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Seeing that vile act, people spat in contempt.

definition: work done or articles made by manual skills.
example_en: That sculpture was the result of his manual skill.

definition: to find out or estimate the extent, dimensions, etc. of, esp. by the use of a standard; to measure.
example_en: The engineer measured the width of the land.

definition: to jump or leap forward or up.
example_en: The child leaped up with joy.

definition: a river which has many rocks along its bed.
example_en: Swimming in that rocky river is dangerous.

definition: to be or remain suspended from above; to be hanging; to be hung.
example_en: A rope was hanging suspended above the well.

definition: that which covers something; a cover, veil, screen or lid.
example_en: She covered the vessel with a cloth cover and kept it shut.

definition: the colour beyond the violet end of the visible spectrum; ultra-violet colour.
example: ಸೂರ್ಯನಿಂದ ಬರುವ ಅತಿನೇರಿಳೆ ಕಿರಣಗಳು ಚರ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾನಿಕರ.
example_en: The ultra-violet rays coming from the sun are harmful to the skin.

definition: to play a water-sport.
example_en: The children played water-sports in the lake and were delighted.

definition: a lake or pond of sweet (pleasant) water.
example_en: Ducks were swimming in the sweet-water pond outside the village.

definition: an approximating of quantity, numbers, weight, etc. by just looking.
example_en: He estimated the weight of the sack by just looking at it.

definition: a banner or flag containing a symbol representing the kingship or the pontifical insignia.
example_en: The royal banner was flying in front of the palace.

definition: the plant Atalantia monophylla (=Limonia monophylle) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: Wild-lime plants are found at the edge of the forest.

definition: a boy or man as he is related to either or both parents; a male descendant; a son.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ತನ್ನ ಗೊವರನಿಗೆ ಸಿಹಿ ತಿಂಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: The grandmother gave sweets to her son.

definition: to pound the parched paddy heavily to make it flat; to pound (anything) like that.
example_en: Grandmother pounded the parched paddy flat to make flattened rice.

definition: the state or quality of being impure; impurity.
example: ಆ ನೀರಿನ ಮೈಲಗೆಯಿಂದ ಜನರು ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾದರು.
example_en: People fell ill due to the impurity of that water.

definition: a huge rock.
example: ಗದ್ದೆಯ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಅರೆಕಲ್ಲು ಅಡ್ಡ ಬಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A huge rock lay in the middle of the field.

definition: a woman who sings for an actress in a movie.
example_en: The playback singer sang melodiously for that movie.

definition: to come or be received as a guest.
example_en: He came as a guest to the neighboring house.

definition: a definite quantity of food.
example_en: A fixed quantity of food was given to the workers every day.

definition: any disease that is communicated or communicable from one person to another or others; a communicable, transmittable disease.
example_en: The hospital staff took care to prevent the transmittable disease from spreading.

definition: the plant Musa sapientum (var. martabanica) of Musaceae family.
example_en: The banana plant in the backyard bore a bunch.

definition: a wandering in a forest, esp. for recreational purpose.
example_en: During the summer holidays we went on a forest excursion.

definition: any of various mental functional disorders characterised by anxiety, compulsions, phobias, depression, dissociations, etc.; neurosis.
example_en: He developed neurosis due to stress.

definition: a reply, explanation or reason which is not true.
example: ಅವನು ಸುಳ್ಳು ಕುಂಟಜವಾಬು ಹೇಳಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ನೋಡಿದನು.
example_en: He tried to escape by giving a false excuse.

definition: the rattan Calamus rotang of Arecaceae family.
example: ಬುಟ್ಟಿ ಹೆಣೆಯಲು ಅವಳು ಬೇಡಿಸು ಕಡಿದು ತಂದಳು.
example_en: She cut and brought rattan cane to weave the basket.

definition: a kind of medicinal powder, taken by inhaling.
example_en: He inhaled the medicinal powder through his nose.

definition: any of the lotus plants.
example_en: The lotus blossomed in the morning sunlight.

definition: bent or turned slightly.
example_en: The plant's branch was slightly bent by the wind.

definition: the cultivated produce of the ground, while growing; crop.
example_en: The farmer watered the growing crop.

definition: a heavy stroke or punch.
example_en: He received a heavy punch.

definition: a slight injury, mar or mark, usu. thin and shallow, caused by scratching; a scratch.
example: ಬೆಕ್ಕಿನ ಪಂಜದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕೈಗೆ ಚಿವರುಗಾಯ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: He got a scratch on his hand from the cat's paw.

definition: a round mark put usu. on the face, to protect against the influences of evil spirits.
example_en: The mother put a protective mark on the child's cheek.

definition: a kind of liquor.
example_en: People consumed the liquor during the festival.

definition: a childless widow.
example_en: She is living as a childless widow.

definition: the tree Cedrus libani of Coniferae family; Indian cedar.
example_en: The tree called gandugurugi grows tall.

definition: an utterly poor or insolvent man.

example_en: Her face with its parrot-like hooked nose drew people's attention.

definition: the day on which the sun changes the direction of his apparent journey at the Tropic of Capricorn (23o26' south of the celestial equator), regarded as most auspicious for rituals.

definition: to join (one thing to another); to attach; to connect; to fasten.

definition: the husk of paddy, wheat or other grain separated in hulling, threshing or winnowing; chaff; hull.

definition: any of the various senna plants belonging to the family Caesalpiniaceae, esp. Cassia pumila.

definition: an advanced, higher rank, position in a hierarchy.

example_en: The heinous murder that took place in the village shocked everyone.

definition: the quality or state of being modest; esp. a) unassuming or humble behavior; b) lack of excesses or pretensions; moderation; c) decency; decorum; modesty.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ವ್ರೀಡೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿತು.

example_en: That ill-tempered man gets angry even over small matters.

definition: requiring careful consideration or thought; involving difficulty, effort or considered action; serious; severe.

definition: knowing; perceiving; learning.
example_en: That perceiving man grasped the truth.

example_en: The doctor checked the correct dosage in the pharmacopoeia.

definition: a variegated sīre (sari, the traditional long unsewn cloth used by women).

definition: to present a gift as a mark of friendship, affection, etc.

example_en: He slipped and fell on the slippery floor.

definition: a fragrant thing.
example_en: That flower is truly a fragrant thing.

definition: a joke; a fun; sport.
example_en: All the friends gathered and were absorbed in joking and fun.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The division of property took place fairly.

definition: the fact or condition of being invalid and ineffective under the law; the process of making so.
example_en: The court declared the invalidity of that agreement.

definition: to write on something (with a pen, pencil, chalk, stylus, etc.).
example_en: The child wrote letters on the slate.

definition: a tropical plant of Araceae family, with shield-shaped leaves, cultivated for its edible corms.
example_en: They used the white kesavu corm for cooking.

definition: a very intelligent man.
example: ಆ ಅತಿಚದುರ ಎಂತಹ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯನ್ನೂ ಬೇಗ ಬಿಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That very intelligent man solves any problem quickly.

definition: a flat, wingless, bloodsucking hemipterous insect, Cimex lectularius, that infests houses and esp. beds and furniture; a bed-bug.
example_en: Bed-bugs were biting in the old bed.

definition: any of a large family (Aphididae) of small, soft-bodied homopteran insects that suck the juice from plants; a plant louse; an aphid.
example: ಸಸ್ಯಹೇನುಗಳು ಎಲೆಗಳ ರಸವನ್ನು ಹೀರಿ ಗಿಡವನ್ನು ಹಾಳು ಮಾಡಿದವು.
example_en: Aphids sucked the juice from the leaves and ruined the plant.

definition: the mood of a person who has been distressed or agonised.
example_en: That woman with a distressed heart sat silently.

definition: cattle excrement used to fertilise soil; manure.
example_en: Cattle manure increases the fertility of the soil.

definition: to fix an object as a target (to hit, shoot, at).
example_en: The hunter took aim at the deer.

definition: the quality of being swift, vehement or forceful.
example_en: That blow had great force.

definition: a path, way or course.
example: ಈ ದಾರಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಊರಿನ ಮಧ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This path goes straight to the middle of the village.

definition: the state or period of being an infant; childhood; infancy.
example_en: His childhood passed under his grandmother's care.

definition: the quality of being harsh, rough, rude; harshness; rudeness.
example_en: Harshness was clearly evident in his words.

definition: a kind of hand-posture done while meditating.
example_en: In meditation, he performed the hand-posture of peace.

definition: to cut into pieces; to break into fragments.
example_en: The cook cut the vegetable into pieces.

definition: a dent made by a bite of teeth.
example_en: The dent made by teeth bite was clearly visible on the fruit.

definition: a small fortified place, town, etc.
example_en: A tall fort surrounded that fortified town.

definition: an appointing or being appointed.
example_en: The appointment of new teachers happened recently.

definition: a lord; a master.
example_en: That master is the big merchant of the town.

definition: (dial.) (a nursery term) a cradle.
example_en: The mother laid the baby in the cradle.

definition: to fill with fear or terror; to frighten; to scare.
example_en: That ghost story frightened the children.

definition: any of various birds (family Motacillidae) related to the pipits and having a trim slender body and a very long tail that they habitually jerk up and down; wagtail.
example: ಉಲಿವಕ್ಕಿ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಬಾಲವನ್ನು ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The wagtail sat on the stone and jerked its tail upward.

definition: the plant Trachyspermum ammi ( = Carum copiticum) of Apiaceae family; bishop's weed.
example_en: The brahmadarbhe plant is used for digestive strength.

definition: the chief accounts officer in a palace.
example_en: The palace's chief accounts officer managed all the accounts.

definition: a difficult situation; difficulty; distress; strait.
example_en: Because of financial difficulty, he had to ask for a loan.

definition: the bird Falco cheela of Falconidae family, with long, pointed wings and a short, curved, notched beak; the Bengal kite; the falcon.
example_en: The falcon circled in the sky to hunt.

definition: to deprive another of courage, resoluteness.
example_en: The news of the defeat deprived him of his courage.

definition: personal knowledge derived as a result of study, experience, etc.
example_en: The teacher's knowledge guided the disciples.

definition: name of a holy city in Bihār, in North India.
example_en: Gaya in Bihar is famous as a holy place.

definition: the quality of rustic, i.e. lacking refinement, elegance, polish or sophistication.
example_en: The rustic lack of refinement was clearly visible in his speech.

definition: to come out; to send out; to ooze out.
example_en: Blood oozed out from the wound.

definition: having no equal; matchless; peerless.
example_en: His valor was matchless.

definition: a man, who leads an unrestrained, sexually immoral life; a rake; a libertine.
example_en: That adulterous rake lost everyone's respect.

definition: the tendency to murder.
example: ಆ ದುಷ್ಟನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲ್ಲಾಸೆ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That wicked man's tendency to murder grew day by day.

definition: to tie, fasten or intertwine in or with a knot or knots.
example: ಹಗ್ಗವನ್ನು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಗಂಟಿಕ್ಕು ಎಂದು ಅಪ್ಪ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: Father told me to tie the rope tightly with a knot.

definition: the science of studying that truth which lies beyond the human miṇḍs comprehension; parapsychology.
example: ಅತಿಮಾನಸ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಮೀರಿದ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Parapsychology studies the truth that lies beyond the mind.

definition: not permanent; not lasting; impermanent.
example_en: All the pleasures of this world are impermanent.

definition: to join or fasten (two things together.
example_en: The carpenter joined the two planks together well.
